archetypes.name: dyn-cursor-model
archetypes.rationale: Per-slot Cursor model override and retry replay are the riskiest behavior changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Cursor model override path from review.panel manifest rows through dispatch-waterfall, launch-review, metadata persistence, and collect-results retry. Verify ordinary Cursor lanes still use the configured default while only plan-fidelity-auto pins auto. Check validation rejects malformed cursor_model values without breaking Codex model_role behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
